recipes.ghg_method: GWP100: IPCC AR6 for CO₂ (1), CH₄ (29.8) and N₂O (273). The single native CH₄ row mixes fossil-fuel extraction and refining (about 40%) with agriculture and waste (about 58%); it uses the fossil value, as MARIO's calc_ghg hybrid profile does, and 27 for the non-fossil share would lower the world total by about 1%. The source's HFC, PFC and SF₆ rows are empty, so F-gases are not covered. Emissions from unregistered waste, which the source reports separately from activity emissions, are added. Biogenic CO₂ excluded. The HIOT extension file reports 2.4% more fossil CO₂ for activities than the HSUT file; each table is used as published. Production accounts; direct final-demand emissions calculated separately and included once in Whole economy.
